verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's public pricing page (docs-13, docs-28, docs-29) lists a free tier and volume-based limits (e.g., 'Up to 20M events/month', 'Up to 100M metrics data points/month') without requiring a sales call, giving SREs a rough sense of per-signal cost thresholds. However, the evidence pack shows no explicit dollar-per-event/per-span/per-metric rate table or confirmation that higher (enterprise) tiers avoid sales contact, and community commentary (comm-2) flags real-world cost unpredictability once usage scales. missing for 10: explicit $ price per unit of telemetry for all tiers, confirmation that top-tier/enterprise pricing is also self-serve rather than sales-gated.
